# AI FinOps — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Cost model

*Module 1: Unit economics · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_unit_economics.py`): Compute the three unit costs for one of your features. Which one would your CFO recognise? Which one would your product owner act on?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Apply three controls

*Module 2: Controls · about 48 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_apply_three_controls.py`): Pick the three controls with the best saving-to-risk ratio for YOUR workload. Estimate the monthly saving and name the owner for each.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Dashboard spec

*Module 3: Reporting · about 24 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_dashboard_and_budget_alerts.py`): Write your dashboard spec: six tiles, each with an owner and a threshold. Which tile would have caught your last surprise?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
